result.title: OccJEPA: Occlusion as Masking for Amodal Video Segmentation
result.comment: 20 pages (8-page main paper + supplementary material). Code: https://github.com/zgp110/occjepa
result.summary: Amodal video segmentation asks for the complete mask of an object in every frame, including the parts hidden behind other objects. The best current methods generate these masks with fine-tuned video diffusion models, which need many denoising steps and an extra depth network, and give a different answer for every sample. Self-supervised video world models of the JEPA family are trained on a closely related task: predicting the representation of masked space-time regions from the visible ones. We therefore treat occlusion as masking. The tokens that the object's visible mask does not cover are dropped, the pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 predictor fills them in, and a light head decodes the observed and predicted features into amodal masks. The resulting model, OccJEPA (Occlusion-as-masking JEPA), is deterministic and 33.5x faster than the diffusion-based state of the art, and more accurate on SAIL-VOS, on TAO-Amodal, including a held-out test split (+4.00 AP50) and visible masks tracked by SAM2, and on Kubric. Controlled experiments trace the gain to the predictor's pre-trained weights rather than to its capacity, for world models from 87M to 1.85B parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/zgp110/occjepa.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 OccJEPA，把遮挡视为掩码：丢弃物体可见掩码之外的 token，用预训练 V-JEPA 2.1 预测器补全，再由轻量解码头把观测与预测特征解码为 amodal 掩码；方法确定性、比扩散式 SOTA 快 33.5 倍，在多数据集上 AP50 更高。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作属视频分割而非 VLM 推理，但其「以可见 token 为条件、由预训练预测器补全被遮挡区域的 latent」及「增益来自预训练权重而非模型容量」的对照，可供核查 LVR 中内部状态补全视觉细节的来源与计算成本。
